arxiv-1910-07720.title: Riemann-Hilbert approach to the modified nonlinear Schrödinger equation with non-vanishing asymptotic boundary conditions
arxiv-1910-07720.creator: Yiling YANG, Engui FAN
arxiv-1910-07720.description: Abstract The modified nonlinear Schrödinger (NLS) equation was proposed to describe the nonlinear propagation of the Alfven waves and the femtosecond optical pulses in a nonlinear single-mode optical fiber. In this paper, the inverse scattering transform for the modified NLS equation with non-vanishing asymptotic boundary at infinity is presented.

arxiv-2101-08425.title: Some punctured codes of several families of binary linear codes
arxiv-2101-08425.creator: Xiaoqiang Wang, Dabin Zheng, Cunsheng Ding
arxiv-2101-08425.description: Abstract Abstract. Two general constructions of linear codes with functions over finite fields have been extensively studied in the literature. The first one is given by \mathcal{C}(f)=\left\{{\rm Tr}(af(x)+bx)_{x\in\mathbb{F}_{q^{m}}^{*}}:a,b\in\mathbb{F}_{q^{m}}\right\} , where q is a prime power, {\mathbb{F}}_{q^{m}}^{*}={\mathbb{F}}_{q^{m}}\setminus\{0\} , {\mathrm{Tr}} is the trace function from {\mathbb{F}}_{q^{m}} to {\mathbb{F}}_{q} , and f(x) is a function from \mathbb{F}_{q^{m}} to \mathbb{F}_{q^{m}} with f(0)=0 .

arxiv-2201-03579.title: The combined and respective roles of imaging and stellar kinematics in identifying galaxy merger remnants 2015 The combined and respective roles of imaging and stellar kinematics in identifying galaxy merger remnants – A
arxiv-2201-03579.creator: Connor Bottrell, Maan H. Hani, Hossen Teimoorinia, David R. Patton, & Sara L. Ellison
arxiv-2201-03579.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Connor Bottrell, Maan H. Hani, Hossen Teimoorinia, David R. Patton, & Sara L. Ellison. One of the central challenges to establishing the role of mergers in galaxy evolution is the selection of pure and complete merger samples in observations. In particular, while large and reasonably pure interacting galaxy pair samples can be obtained with relative ease via spectroscopic criteria, automated selection of post-coalescence merger remnants is restricted to the physical characteristics of remnants alone.

arxiv-2307-06557.title: The kinematics of young stellar population in the W5 region of the Cassiopeia OB6 association: implication on the formation process of stellar associations Journal: AJ Facilities: MMT:6.5m xcsao ( Kurtz & Mink 1998 ) , NumPy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , Scipy ( Virtanen et al. 2020 )
arxiv-2307-06557.creator: Beomdu Lim, Jongsuk Hong, Jinhee Lee, Hyeong-Sik Yun, Narae Hwang, Byeong-Gon Park
arxiv-2307-06557.description: Abstract The star-forming region W5 is a major part of the Cassiopeia OB6 association. Its internal structure and kinematics may provide hints of the star formation process in this region. Here, we present a kinematic study of young stars in W5 using the Gaia data and our radial velocity data.

arxiv-2309-12280.title: Characterizing the topological properties of one-dimensional non-hermitian systems without the Berry-Zak phase
arxiv-2309-12280.description: Abstract A new method is proposed to predict the topological properties of one-dimensional periodic structures in wave physics, including quantum mechanics. From Bloch waves, a unique complex valued function is constructed, exhibiting poles and zeros. The sequence of poles and zeros of this function is a topological invariant that can be linked to the Berry-Zak phase.

arxiv-2311-06314.title: Constraint programming methods in three-dimensional container packing
arxiv-2311-06314.creator: Szymon Wróbel
arxiv-2311-06314.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Szymon Wróbel. Cutting and packing problems are present in many, at first glance unconnected, areas, therefore it’s beneficial to have a good understanding of their underlying structure, to select proper techniques for finding solutions. Cutting and packing problems are a class of combinatorial problems in which there are specified two classes of objects: big and small items and the task is to place the small items within big items.

arxiv-2406-19850.title: Topologically protected quantized changes of the distance between atoms
arxiv-2406-19850.creator: Ali Emami Kopaei, Krzysztof Giergiel, Krzysztof Sacha
arxiv-2406-19850.description: Abstract Thouless pumping enables the transport of particles in a one-dimensional periodic potential if the potential is slowly and periodically modulated in time. The change in the position of particles after each modulation period is quantized and depends solely on the topology of the pump cycle, making it robust against perturbations.

arxiv-2409-05849.title: Quantum Wasserstein Compilation: Unitary Compilation using the Quantum Earth Mover’s Distance
arxiv-2409-05849.creator: Marvin Richter, Abhishek Y. Dubey, Axel Plinge, Christopher Mutschler, Daniel D. Scherer, Michael J. Hartmann
arxiv-2409-05849.description: Abstract Despite advances in the development of quantum computers, the practical application of quantum algorithms requiring deep circuit depths or high-fidelity transformations remains outside the current range of the so-called noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices. Now and beyond, quantum circuit compilation (QCC) is a crucial component of any quantum algorithm execution.

arxiv-2510-02858.title: PINNGraPE: Physics Informed Neural Network for Gravitational wave Parameter Estimation
arxiv-2510-02858.creator: Leigh Smith 1,2, Matteo Scialpi 3,4, Francesco Di Clemente 5 and Michał Bejger 4 , 6 {}^{4,6}\lx@orcidlink{0000-0002-4991-8213}{\orcidlogo}
arxiv-2510-02858.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Leigh Smith 1,2, Matteo Scialpi 3,4, Francesco Di Clemente 5 and Michał Bejger 4 , 6 {}^{4,6}\lx@orcidlink{0000-0002-4991-8213}{\orcidlogo}. Weakly-modelled searches for gravitational waves are essential for ensuring that all potential sources are accounted for in detection efforts, as they make minimal assumptions regarding source morphology. While these searches primarily target generic transient sources, they are also highly effective at identifying a broad range of compact binary coalescences, demonstrated by the weakly-modelled search algorithm coherent WaveBurst being the first to detect GW150914.

pmc-10672246.title: Reutilization of Reclaimed Asphalt Binder via Co-Pyrolysis with Rice Husk: Thermal Degradation Behaviors and Kinetic Analysis
pmc-10672246.creator: Hui Zhao, Bao Mi, Na Li, Teng Wang, Yongjie Xue, Se-Jin Choi
pmc-10672246.description: Realizing the utilization of reclaimed asphalt binder (RAB) and rice husk (RH) to reduce environmental pollution and expand the reutilization technique of reclaimed asphalt pavement (RAP), co-pyrolysis of RAB with RH has great potential. In this study, the co-pyrolysis behaviors, gaseous products, and kinetics were evaluated using thermogravimetric analysis and Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (TG-FTIR).

pmc-10948152.title: Advancing prognostic assessment in primary sclerosing cholangitis: insights from abdominal magnetic resonance imaging and magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography with Anali scores
pmc-10948152.creator: Renato Jose Kist de Mello, Alice Schuch
pmc-10948152.description: uch as cirrhosis and neoplasia (cholangiocarcinoma). Contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the abdomen and magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography, together with clinical and laboratory findings, are essential for the noninvasive diagnosis and surveillance of PSC. Invasive procedures, like endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography, are less accessible and have potential severe complications, such as duodenal perforation and pancreatitis.

pmc-11323277.title: Development of Hollow Fiber Membranes Functionalized with Ionic Liquids for Enhanced CO2 Separation
pmc-11323277.creator: Julia
pmc-11323277.description: The combination of CO2-selective ionic liquids (ILs) with block copolymers, such as Pebax 1657, has demonstrated an enhancement of the gas separation capabilities of polymeric membranes. In the current work, the development of composite membranes by applying a thin, concentrated selective layer made of Pebax/imidazolium-based ionic liquids (ILs) is presented.

pmc-11437664.title: A qualitative exploration of changes and mechanisms of changes in a psychoeducational intervention for family dementia caregivers
pmc-11437664.creator: Stephanie Kipfer, Cedric Mabire, Jean Vézina, Andrea Koppitz, Sandrine Pihet
pmc-11437664.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background‘Learning to feel better… and help better’ is a psychoeducational intervention that aims to empower family caregivers of people with dementia by helping them cope better with the daily stress of dementia caregiving. The intervention has been adapted to a Swiss context and evaluated with a mixed-method design, yielding promising results in caregivers, such as a reduced subjective burden and improved self-efficacy.

pmc-11498076.title: Assessing the Quality of Patient Education Materials on Cardiac Catheterization From Artificial Intelligence Chatbots: An Observational Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11498076.creator: Benjamin J Behers, Christoph A Stephenson-Moe, Rebecca M Gibons, Ian A Vargas, Caroline N Wojtas, Manuel A Rosario, Djhemson Anneaud, Profilia Nord, Karen M Hamad, Joel F Baker
pmc-11498076.description: BackgroundHealth literacy empowers patients to participate in their own healthcare. Personal health literacy is one’s ability to find, understand, and use information/resources to make well-informed health decisions. Artificial intelligence (AI) has become a source for the acquisition of health-related information through large language model (LLM)-driven chatbots.

pmc-11582748.title: Auditory evoked potential electroencephalography-biometric dataset
pmc-11582748.creator: Nibras Abo Alzahab, Angelo Di Iorio, Luca Apollonio, Muaaz Alshalak, Alessandro Gravina, Luca Antognoli, Marco Baldi, Lorenzo Scalise, Bilal Alchalabi
pmc-11582748.description: This work aims to assess the use of electroencephalographic (EEG) signals as a means of biometric authentication. More than 240 recordings, each lasting 2 min, were gathered from 20 subjects involved in the data collection. Data include the results of experiments performed both in a resting state and in the presence of auditory stimuli.

pmc-12371123.title: COVID‐19 Vaccine‐Induced Severe Pneumonitis
pmc-12371123.creator: Tatsuro Suzuki, Hiromi Furuta, Misa Naganawa, Keiko Hayashi, Hiroko Kiyotoshi, Chiharu Ohta, Shigemitsu Ninomiya
pmc-12371123.description: Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID‐19) has resulted in global morbidity, mortality, and societal disruption. COVID‐19 mRNA vaccination was mandatory in many countries for a period; however, severe adverse events have been observed in some individuals who received the vaccine. We report a case of COVID‐19 mRNA vaccine‐induced pneumonitis in a male patient whose cytokine levels were analysed prior to admission.

pmc-12394481.title: Genomic insights into host-associated variants and transmission features of a ToBRFV isolate from Mexico
pmc-12394481.creator: Erika Janet Zamora-Macorra, Daniel Leobardo Ochoa-Martínez, Claudia Yaritza Chavarín-Camacho, Rosemarie W. Hammond, Katia Aviña-Padilla
pmc-12394481.description: Tomato brown rugose fruit virus (ToBRFV) poses a global threat to tomato and pepper production due to its high transmissibility and adaptability. Understanding its genomic features and transmission mechanisms is critical for effective disease management. We characterized the genome and biological properties of a ToBRFV isolate from Mexico.

pmc-12405529.title: Implicit Runge-Kutta based sparse identification of governing equations in biologically motivated systems
pmc-12405529.creator: Mehrdad Anvari, Hamidreza Marasi, Hossein Kheiri
pmc-12405529.description: Identifying governing equations in physical and biological systems from datasets remains a long-standing challenge across various scientific disciplines. Common methods like sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy) often rely on precise derivative approximations, making them sensitive to data scarcity and noise.

pmc-12656930.title: Vaccination Recommendation Patterns and Associated Factors Among Children with Special Health Care Needs: A Cross-Sectional Study in District-Level Immunization Services in China
pmc-12656930.creator: Chenglian Wang, Li Zhang, Binyue Xu, Xiaolan Fu, Li Fu, Bowen Li, Wang Ju, Qingyu Li, Sitong Luo
pmc-12656930.description: Background: Children with special health care needs (CSHCN) are at heightened risk of delayed or missed vaccinations because of clinical complexity and provider uncertainty. Although China has issued expert consensus guidelines and established immunization advisory services, little is known about vaccination decision-making within routine district-level immunization services.

pmc-13100663.title: Phylogeny of Vietnamosasa (Poaceae, Bambusoideae) based on syntenic nuclear genes with description of a new species
pmc-13100663.creator: Xiao Feng, Zu-Chang Xu, Jing-Xia Liu, Mei Chen, Dmitry D. Sokoloff, Constantin I. Fomichev, Meng-Yuan Zhou, De-Zhu Li
pmc-13100663.description: Vietnamosasa is a small paleotropical woody bamboo genus of the Bambusa-Dendrocalamus-Gigantochloa (BDG) complex with unresolved interspecific relationships. It grows in the dry dipterocarp forest and adapts to seasonal dryness and annual burning. Here, we reconstructed the phylogeny of Vietnamosasa using 938 syntenic nuclear genes.
